issues.title: Missing Core Template and Schema Files
issues.why: The spec relies entirely on 'templates/run.ps1' and 'schemas/powershell.schema.json' as the normative implementation source, but these files are not provided in the context.
issues.fix: Include the content of templates/run.ps1 and schemas/powershell.schema.json in the provided context.

issues.title: Acceptance Criteria lack Verifies clauses
issues.why: AC-01 through AC-05 in 97-acceptance-criteria.md describe behaviors but lack the mandatory 'Verifies:' clause linking them to specific spec sections or linter slots.
issues.fix: Add 'Verifies: §00 baseline' or similar anchors to each AC in 97-acceptance-criteria.md.

issues.title: Unresolved Sibling References
issues.why: 00-overview.md and 02-script-reference.md reference '07-runner-interface.md' and 'upload-scripts' which are listed as 'pending creation' or missing from the file list.
issues.fix: Provide 07-runner-interface.md or remove normative dependencies on it from the pipeline contract.
